The '''worrt''' was an amphibious creature native to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], though they could also be found on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] and [[Phaeda/Legends|Phaeda]].

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Worrt.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A worrt]]
Worrts were omnivorous, but was also known to attempt to eat rocks and metal objects,<ref name="CG" /> which led to the demise of many worrts. They used their long, prehensile tongue to catch smaller prey, such as [[Gorg/Legends|gorgs]], but were known to also attack creatures larger than itself. Sometimes, immediately upon eating prey, a worrt would let out a loud belch.

Worrts could, with great difficulty, be trained as housepets. [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] kept a number of worrts as pest control, exploiting the creature's lightning-quick tongue. The worrt counted the native [[ibian]] among its prey. Worrt venom tasted like [[tricopper]] and was strong enough to kill a [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]].

==History==
[[File:WorrtPhaeda-CE3.png|thumb|right|250px|A worrt on Phaeda]]
Worrts were among the exotic (and mostly predatory) flora and fauna of [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder/Legends|Gardulla the Hutt's]] indoor [[Gardulla's pleasure garden|pleasure garden]] in her [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] [[Gardulla the Hutt's Palace/Legends|palace]], near the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]]. One of these, in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], bit deeply into the elbow of the [[Sakiyan/Legends|Sakiyan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Djas Puhr/Legends|Djas Puhr]], who was in hot pursuit of unknown juvenile thieves of Gardulla's 'property': [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], his rescuer-friends, and the beautifully fragile creatures they rescued, the [[Ghostling]] children, which the Hutt had planned to use as living garden ornaments. To deal with the pesky creature that so rudely and painfully interrupted his chase, the Sakiyan used his employer-issued [[Spray stick/Legends|Stokhli spray stick]] to stun the animal, flipping it end over end, and straightaway set it to snoring.<ref name="Episode I Adventures 7: Capture Arawynne">''[[Episode I Adventures 7: Capture Arawynne]]''</ref>

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Animal Control [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Entha Kandela]] tasked a spacer to eliminate a few worrts around [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] to collect sets of intact bones for creature specialists.<ref name="SWG:ACO">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Animal Control Officer|Tatooine}}</ref>

It was said that there were giant worrts&mdash;much larger than 1.5 meters in height&mdash;roaming the tops of the barren mountains of Tatooine.

A close relative of the worrt was the aggressive [[sevorrt]].

==Behind the scenes==
The worrt was a puppet, like many of the creatures seen at Jabba's palace in ''Return of the Jedi''. Its production nickname is simply "road creature."

The worrt is sometimes mistaken for a [[Frog-dog/Legends|frog-dog]].

Some sources indicate Jabba introduced worrts to Tatooine from [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. A picture from ''[[Hutt and Seek]]'' shows a worrt in the swamps of Nal Hutta.

In the video game ''[[Super Star Wars]]'', worrts are colored green and leave sticky orange goo on the ground when killed.
